messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "additional weight reduction is clinically indicated"
set: ["additional weight reduction is clinically indicated", "weight reduction", "no dose reduction is needed", "increase is needed if additional glycemic control is required", "this increase is needed if additional glycemic control is required", "cardiovascular risk reduction", "IV administration indicated when rapid onset of diuresis is desired", "way for kidney-related risk reduction is not fully understood", "assess LDL-C when clinically appropriate", "discontinue treatment after reduction", "reduction depends on therapeutic response", "weight", "weight loss and weight management", "weight loss or weight gain", "take prescribed dose as indicated by healthcare provider", "gaining the right amount of weight is very important"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
